main_text.p: me fallant characterum fere obliteratorum vestigia, author, quod si ita fuerit, patet historiam ab ipso Gregorio ad annum tantum 675.perductam, ab alio ad 683. continuatam.

AlCendi Philosophus] ابو يوسف يعقوب بن اسحق[?] الكندي Abu Yusef Yaacub Ebn Eshak[seu Isaaci] AlCendi, Arabum regibus oriundus, Philosophus φιλόσοφος[?] dictus. Magno fuisse in honore perhibetur apud AlMamunem, AlMotasemum, ejusque filium Ahmedem, Chalifas. Meminit ejus Gregorius noster sub AlMotamedo Motawacceli filio.Hist.Medic.

AlMotanabbi Poeta] ابو الطيب احمد بن الحسين[?] الجعفي الكندي البعروف بالمتنبي AbulTaieb Ahmed EbnolHosain &c. AlIoophi AlCendi, notus nomine AlMotanabbi hinc illi impositio quod ادعى[?] النبوة[?] poeticum aliquando furorem pro Prophetico venditaverit. Natus est in vico quodam Cufa كندة[?] Cendab appellato, unde & ipse AlCendi seu Cendensis, non autem a Cendah quod tribus nomen (monente Ebn Chalecan) eum tribu Allophi, seu Iofiensis fuerit. Corrigendus ergo error p. 41. ubi Cendensibus accensetur. Ut & mendum typographicum p.43.l.26. ubi pro Iofius, Iofiensis, legitur Ioffius, &c.

Altauharius] ابو نصر اسماعيل بن حماد الجوهري الترکي AbuNasr Ifmael Ebn Hammad Altauhari AlTorci, i.e. natione Turca, qui tamen obtinuit ut apud Arabes امام اللغه Sermonis antistes audiat. celebris illius Lexici الصحاح AlSahab (vel juxta alios AlSehab quod Sanum, sincerum, probum, verum denotat,p.43.Allannab.

page.notes: Arabic and Greek lines are copied as far as legible; the Arabic in the first two entries and the Greek word after "Philosophus" are doubtful and marked [?]. The Arabic word "Cufa" line is partly obscured in the scan. Ends mid-sentence ("denotat,") and continues on the next page. Marginal notes: "Hist.Medic." beside the Gregorius entry, "p.43." beside the Altauharius entry, "Allannab." beside its last lines. The Arabic and Greek tokens are placed at their printed positions within the entries.
